subject: planner: remove fullRange check from skyline pruning (#63828)
summary: Reviewed the commit diff vs its first parent (single-parent commit). Only `pkg/planner/core/find_best_task.go` changed: skyline pruning’s pseudo-stats detection now keys off `!AccessPath.IsTablePath()` (instead of `!IsFullScanRange`) and only computes full-index-match for the pseudo-stats heuristic when eq/IN predicates exist. No Blocker/High correctness, SQL semantics, transaction/session, or concurrency issues found; the change is limited to access-path pruning/preference heuristics.
